thread:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] High embeddings QPS detected in us-east-1 pool-embeds. Spike started ~5123456770, severity P2. Paging eng-oncall.

alex: Oncall here — looking. Current aggregate embeddings QPS ~4200 (5m avg), pool CPU 94%, tail latency for embeddings up ~3x, ~5% 429s.

jamie: Noted. We should do a targeted per-endpoint cap rather than global throttle. Proposal: non-enterprise embeddings -> 200 qps, enterprise embeddings -> 1000 qps, rerank -> 100 qps; chat routes unchanged. Staged rollout.

sree: Agree. I'll stage a policy change and monitor. Running dry-run CLI now:
```
rdlctl rate-limit apply --route "/embeddings" --scope non-enterprise --qps 200 --reason "live-mitigation 5123456789"
```

sree: Dry-run ok. Applying stage 1 (non-enterprise).

eng-sre: Heads up — enable fast fallback for embed-heavy flows to cached-embeds route where possible. Also consider increasing prefix KV cache TTL for 10m to reduce regen churn.

mohsin: If we route to cached-embeds we need to be careful about staleness for customers using immediate freshness. Suggest tagging customers that will be affected.

alex: Applying stage 1 now.

oncall-bot: policy.apply.start id=rl-7f2a status=initiated user=sree ts=5123456810

sree: stage1 applied: policy id=rl-7f2a scope=non-enterprise qps=200 -> response: success.

alex: Observing immediate CPU drop on pool-embeds to ~72% and overall embeddings QPS down to ~2.1k. 429s reduced to ~0.8%. Latency still elevated but trending down.

jamie: Good. Hold 2m. If stable, proceed stage 2 (enterprise cap).

sree: Preparing stage2 command:
```
rdlctl rate-limit apply --route "/embeddings" --scope enterprise --qps 1000 --reason "live-mitigation 5123456789"
```

sree: stage2 applied: policy id=rl-8b9c scope=enterprise qps=1000 -> success.

alex: Post-stage2 metrics: pool-embeds CPU 60%, total QPS ~1.3k, 429s at 0.35%, tail latency down 45% from peak.

jamie: Rerank: spike noticed but lower magnitude. We'll apply a temporary cap to rerank endpoints to prioritize chat/embeds. Command:
```
rdlctl rate-limit apply --route "/rerank" --qps 100 --scope global --reason "protect core chat/embeds"
```

mohsin: Applied rerank cap. Note: some customers using rerank-first pipelines may see degraded ranking quality; flagged top three customers for notif.

alex: Customer impact scan:
- cust-alpha: embeddings QPS reduced from 700->150 (non-enterprise) -> minor latency increase, no errors yet.
- cust-beta: enterprise -> unaffected.
- cust-gamma: heavy embed churn, 2% requests served from cache, 0.5% 429s.

jamie: I'll draft a short notification to cust-alpha & cust-gamma with recommended mitigation (batching prompts, increasing cache TTL).

eng-sre: Please paste the exact policy IDs and timestamps in the incident ticket. Also attach metric panels for QPS/CPU/429s covering 5123456700-5123456900.

sree: policy summary:
- rl-7f2a (non-enterprise embeddings) applied 5123456812 qps=200
- rl-8b9c (enterprise embeddings) applied 5123456825 qps=1000
- rl-9d3e (rerank global) applied 5123456840 qps=100

alex: Handoff in 30s to eng-sre for monitoring + postmortem. Leaving channel.

oncall-bot: handoff: from=alex to=eng-sre ts=5123456880 note="monitor for 30m; rollback plan ready"

eng-sre: Oncall takeover — monitoring dashboards. Recommend keeping caps for 20 minutes then gradually relax if stable. Also need a follow-up to automate customer-level throttles by usage tier.

jamie: Agreed. Will open follow-up ticket for tiered auto-sculpting. Also tagging for postmortem: root cause likely sudden embed-heavy job from a 3rd-party integration; need to verify.

mohsin: Metrics 10m after mitigation: embeddings QPS steady ~1.1k, pool-embeds CPU ~55%, 429s ~0.2%. Rolling back non-enterprise cap to 400 qps as test.

sree: rollback command:
```
rdlctl rate-limit update --id rl-7f2a --qps 400 --reason "gradual restore after stabilization"
```

sree: update success.

alex: Leaving note for postmortem: timeline, policy IDs, customer impact summary, recommended remediation (auto-tier limits, better pre-warm for cache-heavy customers, alert on sudden embed-job patterns).

oncall-bot: [RESOLVED] Live mitigation completed. Final metrics attached to incident ticket INC-5123456789. If regressions occur reopen or @eng-sre. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre: Will own postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
